tutorial.step.welcome.title: Welcome to Espetro
tutorial.step.welcome.body: AuraTip tips explain each phase and GUI. Close a tip to continue. Use /espetro tutorial skip to skip this session; reopen from the hub or command.
tutorial.step.hub.title: Hub screen
tutorial.step.hub.body: Shows online count and status. After an admin starts a match you enter map vote. Entering the tutorial closes the hub and plays this guide.
tutorial.step.map_vote.title: Map vote screen
tutorial.step.map_vote.body: Click map cards to vote; click again to change. Cards show name and tally. Highest vote loads when the timer ends; ties are random.
tutorial.step.map_loading.title: Map loading
tutorial.step.map_loading.body: Chat reports battlefield loading. Stay in the hub; do not rely on old save dimensions. Team select follows.
tutorial.step.team_select.title: Team select screen
tutorial.step.team_select.body: Attack/Defend icons. Click to join; selected side gets a red/blue frame. You may reselect until the timer ends. Press K if the UI closed.
tutorial.step.commander_vote.title: Commander vote
tutorial.step.commander_vote.body: Vote for a teammate as commander. Timeout picks by votes or random. Commanders use Alt radial skills and vehicles.
tutorial.step.faction_select.title: Formation select
tutorial.step.faction_select.body: The commander picks a TO&E card (classes/vehicles), not a personal class. Scroll the card grid; both sides then reveal.
tutorial.step.faction_reveal.title: Formation reveal
tutorial.step.faction_reveal.body: Brief show of final formations, then the unified deploy panel opens.
tutorial.step.deploy_panel.title: Unified deploy (J)
tutorial.step.deploy_panel.body: Three columns: squads, classes/deploy points, tactical map. Open with J in deploy/battle. Prefer squad + deploy point before class.
tutorial.step.squad.title: Squads
tutorial.step.squad.body: Join or create a squad with a category. Leaders manage members and can place Rally from the Alt radial.
tutorial.step.class_select.title: Classes & variants
tutorial.step.class_select.body: Class buttons show [current/cap]. Full slots are red. Multi-variant classes open a submenu. Some classes need a squad first.
tutorial.step.deploy_point.title: Deploy points
tutorial.step.deploy_point.body: Pick main spawn, outpost (defend deploy phase), HAB, or Rally, then confirm. After choosing a point you may Esc; press J later to change class.
tutorial.step.keys_radial.title: Keys & Alt radial
tutorial.step.keys_radial.body: K: status/team; J: deploy panel. Hold Left Alt for the AuraTip radial: root slots Deploy, Logistics, and Skills (commander). Aim and release Alt to confirm.
tutorial.step.radio_rally.title: Radial → Deploy
tutorial.step.radio_rally.body: Deploy Radio needs the building wand and commander/leader rights. Deploy Rally is squad-leader only, no item cost, place on a valid look target.
tutorial.step.logistics_fob.title: Radial → Logistics
tutorial.step.logistics_fob.body: Deposit tagged supplies into a nearby friendly Radio/FOB. FOB Status reports stock. You can also right-click the Radio.
tutorial.step.commander_skills.title: Radial → Skills
tutorial.step.commander_skills.body: Commanders only. Default KubeJS: drone scan, vehicle supply, 155 arty (ESPoints map). Cooldowns shown; server re-checks rights.
tutorial.step.outpost.title: Outposts
tutorial.step.outpost.body: Defend-only during deploy phase as deploy targets. Removed when battle starts.
tutorial.step.battle.title: Battle
tutorial.step.battle.body: Troop counts, capture points, stamina apply. Attack wait barrier drops at battle start. Use the tactical map; deaths cost troops.
tutorial.step.respawn.title: Death & redeploy
tutorial.step.respawn.body: After death pick a spawn in the deploy panel. Some Rallies wait for a wave. Confirm to return; J adjusts loadout.
tutorial.step.score_round.title: Scoreboard & round end
tutorial.step.score_round.body: Open the scoreboard from deploy/battle. After the round everyone returns to the hub and the temp battlefield is deleted.
tutorial.step.mid_join.title: Mid-join
tutorial.step.mid_join.body: Joining mid-match: pick team, deploy point, class, then enter. Use this tutorial to review the UIs.
